_header: ===== cherrypick-ensemble -- the eight arms of research item 75 in paper (EXPERIMENTAL, paper-only) =====
_what_this_is: Short-dated SPX and GLD option arms, each one configured variant decided by the same engine the backtest uses (engine.decide). Paper only: a position is a ledger row, never an order. Copy to ~/.cherrypick/config/ensemble.json (or a git-ignored config.json here). The orchestrator runs the loop only while modules.ensemble.enabled is true.
_source_note: stream_cache_db overrides the shared stream cache path; null means the suite default.

events._note: path of the event-date file the arms' skip_events read (CPI and sentiment dates); null means ~/.cherrypick/data/public/item75/events.json, written by packages/backtest/scripts/event_history_item75.py. Without it only the computed labels answer and a data label is recorded unknown for the day.

_defaults_note: max_quote_age_seconds: a quote older than this is not priced against. spot_max_age_seconds: the spot a decision or a trail sample is built on. mark_interval_minutes: open positions are marked this often. stream_lead_minutes: the stream request widens for an arm this long before its entry window opens. trail_grace_minutes: a spot record that began later than this after the open cannot give the opening range or the five-minute bars, so an arm that reads them is refused for the day. Slippage is core.fees' model (tastytrade_costs overrides it here, as in any module).
_symbols_note: root is the OCC root a chain must carry (SPXW keeps the AM-settled SPX monthly out); window_strikes is the ATM window, in strikes a side, the stream request asks for while an arm is about to enter. A symbol an arm uses that is not listed here falls back to the index roots the code knows (SPX is SPXW) and to the symbol itself.
_arms_note: The shipped arms are in cherrypick.ensemble.arms; an entry here is laid over the arm of the same name (top-level keys replaced), and an entry under a new name is a new arm. A misspelt key is refused with its path and the loop does not start. Set enabled to false to switch one off. Names are the suite's own.
